quest.title: Stop, Albert. Stop!
quest.description: A suspicious person is lurking around the Cathedral. Sister Victoria wants someone to deal with them...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright then...

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Thanks so much! Off you go then.

talks.objective: Sweep up the pile of leaves

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shall I contact the Knights of Favonius?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: I thought about doing that...

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: But I have no concrete evidence on him. There's nothing they would be able to do.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: For the greater glory of the Anemo Archon... Please, just get rid of this guy.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Have you finished sweeping yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep. All gone.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Thank you. The Cathedral looks much better now! I'm sure Barbara will feel better for it...

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: But, please don't tell Barbara about this.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: The point here is to reduce her burden; telling her about it would only add to it.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: As we agreed, I'll be on my way now. See? Nothing to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: See you again soon... Maybe? Who knows.

talks.objective: Report to Victoria in the Cathedral

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: I have an update about Albert.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Has he left?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, he's gone.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Well, that's that sorted... But, what on earth were you doing sweeping leaves just now?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Never mind, I suppose no more leaves means one less excuse Albert can use to get near the Cathedral in future.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: These gifts are my way of saying thank-you. Take them, and may the Anemo Archon protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: If there's nothing else, I should get back to work. You should get back to yours, too.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Where are you hiding, you pesky little...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Me? Oh— I'm looking for a very dodgy person.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: His name is Albert and he always lurks around the Cathedral during the day.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: He looks like he's up to no good. I'm worried he's plotting something bad...

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Can you chase him off for me?

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Go, Barbara, go!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Hi, what's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Keeping the Cathedral free of dead leaves is a service to Mondstadt and to Barbara!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sister requests that you leave this place immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Leave? What did I do wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, I've already told the Knights of Favonius all about you and your antics!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: What!? What am I supposed to have done? Tell me!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Me? Me, sneaking around, acting suspiciously, and plotting evil deeds? You guys have got this all wrong!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...Do you know Barbara? She's Mondstadt's angel.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Many people in Mondstadt admire her, including me.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: In fact, I am head of the Barbara fan club.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius will be here shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: L—Let me finish! I really look up to Barbara. I want to be like her — I want to do something for Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: But I'm just an ordinary person with ordinary abilities. The best I can do is to do some sweeping around the Cathedral.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: But Miss Victoria never listens to me, she just says she wants me gone.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Recently I noticed that no one has swept away the leaves around the Cathedral for a while. But if I tried to explain to Miss Victoria, she wouldn't understand...

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Can you help me sweep away the leaves? For Mondstadt... And for Barbara?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fine, if it gets you out of here...

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Hey! I thought I just explained how I'm not a bad guy!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Well, okay. Sweep away the leaves for me, and I'll be gone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius will be the only ones doing any sweeping up around here...

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: I'm trying to do a good deed here! You don't need to report every little thing to the Knights of Favonius!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, you win. I'll be out of here as soon as the leaves are gone.
